_about: The owner's word on who an official is: each entry links a holder named in corrections/officials.json, or in the Secretary of State's county roster, to a person of the General Court's record (their number), or to no one (null). Edited by a person; no generator writes this file. src/parse/build_entities.py reads it (read_owner_links): "links" by office|area|year|name, exactly as its --links list prints them, and "name_forms", a form of a person's name the owner confirmed, by the person's number.
_how: One entry per holder: `person`, the record's number (a string), or null for no one of the record; `said`, the owner's words; `by` and `on`, who said so and the day; `evidence`, what was compared. A name form is `name` and `evidence`, under the person's number.

us-house|1|2025|Chris Pappas.evidence: The officials file names US Representative Chris Pappas, D, New Hampshire's 1st district. The record's member 376509 is Rep. Christopher Pappas, Democrat, Hillsborough 8, 2003-2006; Hillsborough County lies in the 1st district. Name and party agree; Chris is a short form of Christopher, which the rule never links alone. Asked on the review bench whether they are one person, the owner answered "Same person" on 25 November 2026, and in chat that day let it be written here.

us-senate|statewide|2027|Chris Pappas.evidence: The officials file names Chris Pappas, D, as US Senator-elect from 3 January 2027, the same man as the US Representative for the 1st district (the entry above). The owner confirmed him as the record's Rep. Christopher Pappas (member 376509) on 25 November 2026.

secretary-of-state|statewide|2025|David.evidence: The officials file names Secretary of State David M. Scanlan. The record's member 371377 is David M. Scanlan, former Rep. for Grafton 11, 1999-2002; the middle initial M agrees. The office is statewide and carries no party, so nothing else could agree. executive-council|5|2025|David K. Wheele.evidence: The officials file names Executive Councilor David K. Wheeler, R, District 5. Two numbers of the record answer to the name, both David K. Wheeler of Milford, Republican: 203015, the Senate member of 1993-1994 (district 11), and 374017, the House member of 1989-1990 (Hillsborough). Milford is in Council District 5. Asked on the review bench whether the Councilor is the David K. Wheeler of Milford in the record, the owner answered "Same person" on 25 November 2026. Linked here under the Senate number, 203015; that 374017 is the same man rests on her answer, and joining the two numbers belongs to the gap-filling work.
